name: Gus 'The Iron' Skillet

greeting: The Iron Skillet! Best grill this side of the Scorched Wastes!
Gus Skillet! I cook meat! You eat meat! Simple!
No fancy sauces! No secret recipes! Just fire and iron!
Step up! Hungry? You will be! The smell alone!
The grill is hot! The meat is fresh! What more do you need?
Iron Chef? Nah. Iron GRILLER! There's a difference!
I don't do vegetables! Meat! Fish! More meat!
Tired of swamp food? Come to the Skillet! Taste actual FLAVOR!
dialog.grill_philosophy: Fire. Iron. Meat. That's it. That's cooking. All that other stuff? Distraction. The flame does the work. You just don't get in the way.
dialog.roadside_life: Grill on wheels! Follow the customers! The Mire, the Dustbelt, wherever hunger calls! No roof, no walls, just smoke and satisfaction!
dialog.backstory: Used to work the docks. Hated it. Bosses. Unions. Meetings about meetings. One day, I lit a fire and never looked back. Food doesn't argue. Food doesn't organize. Food just... feeds.
rumors: That purple chef in town? Percy? Good cook. Weird. But good. We should grill together sometime.
The foodboys? Amateurs. Flip's fish is okay. Corny's cornbread is dry. Heat? Heat is a menace.
Heard the luchador fighter passes through sometimes. Eats ten meals at once. Respect.
That barrelgob knows things about the old dock days. Things I don't talk about.

time_of_day.morning: Morning prep! Fire needs building! Meat needs spicing!
time_of_day.noon: Lunch rush! The grill never stops!
time_of_day.evening: Evening feast! Best time for serious eating!
time_of_day.night: Last call! Grill needs cleaning! Tomorrow we start again!

mini_quest.stage_1_hook: I need the perfect cut. Bog-boar ribs. The big ones. From the alpha male in the Deep Muck. Dangerous? Sure. Worth it? Absolutely. You look like you can handle a boar.
mini_quest.stage_1_active: Alpha bog-boar. Big tusks, scarred hide, attitude problem. His ribs are legendary. Bring them to me.
mini_quest.stage_2_progress: Been to the Deep Muck? Seen my boar? Careful - he's meaner than he looks.
mini_quest.stage_3_complete: THOSE RIBS! Look at the marbling! The color! This will be my masterpiece! Here - eat free at the Skillet, anytime. And take this. My personal spice blend. Don't share it.

party_reactions.kade: Simple. Honest. Good. I needed this.
party_reactions.nix7: Protein delivery system. Efficient. No unnecessary complexity.
party_reactions.twist: MEAT! GRILLED MEAT! SO MUCH MEAT!
party_reactions.korr: A warrior's meal. Simple. Satisfying. Strong.
party_reactions.renna: No magic in his cooking. Just skill. I find that refreshing.
party_reactions.suresh: He understands fire. Truly understands it. I respect that.
party_reactions.sova: Good food. Good portions. No questions asked.
party_reactions.grit: Reminds me of field cooking. Simple. Hearty. Good.
party_reactions.ashka: The fire... he controls it well. Better than most.
party_reactions.senna: Good location. Sees everyone pass by. And the meat's decent.
party_reactions.callum: I ate until I couldn't move! Best day ever!

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time? Try the house special. Don't ask what's in it. Just enjoy.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back for more! Knew you had good taste!
relationship_dialog.friend: Regular! I'll save you the best cuts!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You've eaten at my grill more times than I can count. You're family now. Here. My father's grill knife. Use it well.

cross_npc_connections: pigman_purple: Percy. Weird little guy. Good cook, though. We talk shop sometimes.
foodboys_blue: Flip tries hard. Respect that. But frying ain't grilling.
lucha_blue: The fighter. Eats enough for three men. Pays enough for four. Good customer.
